page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top with the page number 58 beside it. No marginal notes; a small asterisk stands in the left margin beside the paragraph "Penes me non est". Catchword "mitofis" at the lower right.

main_text.p: ceperant, ita liquet ex iis quæ secuta sunt, ut nullum postea colorem admittat. Cùm enim diversis subinde Propositionibus, & Tractatuum Articulis significarent, quid à me potissimum expeterent, nihil unquam ullius Momenti, vel quoad ipsas Leges, vel Justitiæ Administrationem, exhibitum ab Illis, vel postulatum: id solum (inter alia minora quæ novari voluerant) acerrimè urgebant, Abolen-dum Episcopale, & Presbyterorum Regimen Con-stituendum.

Cætera omnia quovis tempore propositā, vel nihil omnino facientia ad Belli causam, vel a Me facile concessa, vel denique erant hujusmodi quæ Numerum tantum implebant, aut accedebant postea ut confecutiva Belli jam ab illis Injuste inchoati.

Penes me non est quid alii credant efficere, (ii præcipuè, quos illa species Pietatis & Clamor, tum studium Religionis, & Reformandi fervor ita occupant plerunque Præjudicio, ut lux omnis Judicii, & æquitas simul obstruatur.) Hæc tamen (quantum observare potui) vera fuit & est inter nos controversia, & Armorum Causa, quæ hoc fine, in initio ceperunt, ut vel os mihi penitus occluderent, vel consensum vi exprimerent. Et in hac porro Veritate, (quam Deo Teste confirmo) tam remotum me fuisse a Belli Cogitatione, quam eram Mundo coram ab omnibus Rebus Impa-ratissimus ita acquiescit conscientia Mea, & id invenit solatii in mediis suis Adversis, & cala-

page.notes: The running head is printed in Greek capitals (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ); some letters in the scan are close to Latin shapes, so the Greek reading is a best reading. The asterisk in the left margin beside "Penes" is a printer's mark, not a note. The right edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The page ends with the hyphenated "cala-" and the catchword "mitofis" completes it on the next page.
